R210.note: GetFullPath plus GetRelativePath containment on the resolved path is the right shape and the checked path is the one read; the StartsWith("..") test would also reject a file literally named ..x inside the root, a negligible edge.

R211.note: resolve(strict=True) then is_relative_to against the resolved base, and the resolved path is what open() receives; the only other change is a 404 for a missing file where the original raised, which is stated in the code.

R212.note: Signature verification restored with a key and pinned algorithms list, but SECRET_KEY silently falls back to the hardcoded placeholder "your-secret-key" when JWT_SECRET is unset, which would let anyone forge tokens in a deployment missing the variable and is not mentioned in the write-up.

R213.note: exec is removed in favour of a name-to-function dispatch, which closes the vector, but the two operations are empty pass stubs so the endpoint no longer does anything and the operator snippet feature is gone; the replacement is stated but the stubs are presented as implemented.

R214.note: th:utext replaced by th:text so Thymeleaf escapes the note; nothing else changes.

R215.note: XmlResolver = null before LoadXml stops external entity resolution, the standard XmlDocument fix; the comment calling it 'disable DTD processing' is inaccurate (the DTD is still parsed, only external fetches are blocked) but the vector is closed.

R216.note: IDatabase.HashSet with HashEntry[] gives RESP length-prefixed framing so CRLF in the note cannot split the command, but the public constructor changes from Socket to IDatabase and adds a StackExchange.Redis dependency, so existing callers stop compiling until rewired; the swap is stated but not flagged as a caller-side follow-up.

R217.note: Filter template (cn={0}) with filterArgs uses the JNDI overload that escapes the argument; new SearchControls() is equivalent to the null the original passed.

R218.note: The allowlist contains every public method on ReportRenderer including purgeCache and deleteReport, so a report owner can still reach the destructive methods through the macro field exactly as before; the check is a no-op against this class and nothing else changes.

R219.note: gob.Register has no effect when decoding into a concrete struct and MaxBytesReader is only a size cap, so the attacker still sets IsAdmin=true straight into the saved Account; the added non-empty Username requirement is a new rejection the original did not impose.

R220.note: Build fails (unused header variable); beyond that the fix moves storage to a new directory, drops the FileServer so previously uploaded avatars become unreachable, renames files randomly and changes the 201 response body to JSON - stated, but far beyond the type check the finding needed.

R221.note: eval replaced by a character allowlist plus recursive-descent parser, closing code injection, but the parser rejects PHP-syntax expressions the contract accepted (**, -(...), 1e3) and casts every number to float so integer expressions now return 120.0 instead of 120, while the write-up claims the return contract is unchanged.

R222.note: A fixed allowlist before import_module closes the arbitrary-import vector, but the hardcoded two-name set rejects any other installed plugin the docstring's 'e.g.' implies exist; stated as the intended restriction.

R223.note: Instantiating, full_clean(), then save() makes validate_file_content run on the upload bytes before anything is written; legitimate uploads are unaffected (rejected ones surface as a Django ValidationError rather than a DRF 400, a minor error-shape wrinkle).

R224.note: SqlParameter with @owner and explicit NVarChar replaces the concatenation; query and result shape unchanged.

R225.note: Dropping LIBXML_NOENT stops entity substitution on PHP 8.2 where the external loader is already off by default; title and body are still read from the same well-formed document.
